_meta.description: Bajkoterapia v2 prompts — photorealistic photo inside a polaroid frame with cartoon stickers. The reference image is sent alongside every prompt as a visual anchor.

service.hero: Cozy bedroom photo, matching the visual style of the reference image: a 5-year-old child with soft blonde hair sitting cross-legged on a fluffy white rug, holding open a magical hardcover Bajkoterapia book in their lap. The book pages glow warmly with a subtle magic light. The child looks up with a wide delighted smile, eyes bright. Mom sits softly out-of-focus to the right side of the frame (visible shoulder, profile of hair only — focus stays on the child). Background: warm bedroom with white wood bookshelves, plush giraffe and teddy bear toys on the shelves, a soft blue bed, gentle afternoon light pouring in from a window on the left. Photorealistic, cinematic 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Polaroid frame with thicker white bottom edge, slight rotation around 2 degrees, soft drop shadow. Cartoon decorative stickers around the polaroid: a small plush teddy bear bottom-left (partially overlapping the polaroid edge), a soft pink heart on the right side, golden magical sparkles drifting from top-right.
service.step-01-temat: A parent and child looking together at a tablet or laptop on a kitchen table at golden hour. The child (around age 6, brown hair) is pointing curiously at the screen. Mom is leaning in beside them, smiling. On the screen we see only soft glow — no readable interface. Cup of tea, an open notebook, soft warm light from window behind. Concept: choosing a story topic together. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a small heart bottom-left.
service.step-02-dziecko: A tender close-up photo of a parent's hands writing in a notebook on their lap, while a small child (age 4, dark hair) sits beside them holding up a beloved plush bunny. The parent's face is partially visible from the side, smiling warmly. Cozy living room, soft lamp light. Concept: a parent describing their unique child. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a tiny cartoon bunny sticker bottom-left and gold sparkles top-right.
service.step-03-ksiazka: An emotional close-up: a child (age 5-6) holding their newly arrived personalized hardcover Bajkoterapia book with both hands, eyes wide with wonder, mouth slightly open in awe. The book has a beautiful magical illustrated cover (no readable text). Soft window light from the side, warm bedroom in background. Concept: the moment of receiving the finished book. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon heart on the right and golden sparkles drifting around the book.
service.why-01-self: A child sitting on a soft bed, holding open a book and looking down at one specific illustrated page that shows a small character clearly resembling themselves (same hair, same pajamas). The child has a stunned, magical realization look on their face. Soft warm bedside lamp, evening light. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a small cartoon mirror sticker on the right and gold sparkles top-right.
service.why-02-distance: A child (age 5) sitting safely in a parent's lap on a comfy armchair, both reading a magical book together. The child's expression is calm, curious — processing something gentle on the page. The parent's chin rests softly on top of the child's head. Cozy living room, soft afternoon light, blanket draped around them. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a small cartoon teddy bottom-left and a soft pink heart on the right.
service.why-03-guide: A close-up photo of an open hardcover children's book held in a child's lap, the page showing a magical illustrated scene of a small wise glowing creature (like a kind owl or forest spirit) reaching out a paw. The child's small hand is touching the page. Soft golden lamp light from above. Concept: the magical guide character helping the hero. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a tiny cartoon owl sticker bottom-left and gold sparkles top-right.
service.why-04-structure: Overhead photo of a wooden table with five small Bajkoterapia hardcover books arranged in a gentle curving line, each book slightly different cover (different magical scene). A child's small hand is placing the third book in the row. Warm wood, soft cream tablecloth, golden hour light from the side. Concept: stages of a story, journey, structure. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with golden sparkles top-right and a small cartoon heart bottom-left.
service.story-founders: A tender bedtime moment: two warm parents sitting on the edge of a child's bed, leaning in close. One parent is telling a story with animated hand gestures, the other is smiling. The child (age 4, peeking from under a fluffy blanket) is wide-eyed with wonder. Bedside lamp casts warm golden light. Cozy bedroom with soft toys on shelves. Concept: parents inventing a magical bedtime story for their child. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a small cartoon moon top-right and a heart on the right.
service.cta-bedtime: A wide warm bedtime photo from a slight back-side angle: a parent and child snuggled together in bed, both reading the personalized Bajkoterapia book by the soft light of a bedside lamp. We see the parent's arm wrapped around the child, both of their faces softly illuminated by the book's warm glow. Window in background shows a starry night sky. Mood: pure intimacy, the moment Bajkoterapia is for. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a soft pink heart on the right.

themes.theme-lek-ciemnosci: A small child (age 4) in cozy pajamas peeking out from under a fluffy blanket in their dimly lit bedroom, holding a small glowing nightlight in the shape of a star. The child has a brave, curious expression — not afraid, gently smiling. Soft moonlight through the window. Plush bunny beside the pillow. Concept: feeling safe in the dark. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon crescent moon top-right and a tiny star bottom-left.
themes.theme-przedszkole: A child (age 3-4) standing at the colorful entrance gate of a sunny preschool, wearing a tiny backpack and holding their parent's hand. The parent is kneeling beside them, gently smiling and adjusting the backpack strap. Other small children softly out of focus playing in the background. Bright morning light. Concept: brave first day, supported. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a tiny heart on the parent's hand area.
themes.theme-zlosc: A close-up tender photo of a child (age 5) sitting cross-legged on a soft rug in a cozy room, taking a deep breath with eyes closed. A parent's hand rests gently on the child's back, supportive. Soft afternoon window light. The child's expression is calming, a small almost-smile returning. Concept: anger acknowledged and softened with love. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon soft pink heart on the right side.
themes.theme-zazdrosc-rodzenstwo: An older child (age 5) sitting on a windowsill of a sunlit room, looking thoughtfully out the window while hugging a worn beloved teddy bear close to their chest. In the soft background, slightly out of focus, a parent gently rocking a baby. Mood: tender, complex, loved. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon teddy bear bottom-left and a small heart on the right.
themes.theme-strata-bliskiej: A child (age 6) sitting peacefully in a sunlit meadow at golden hour, holding a single dandelion. The child looks up at the sky with a gentle, contemplative half-smile — peaceful, not sad. A small bird perches on a stone nearby. Concept: tender remembrance, hope. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon golden sparkles top-right and a soft pink heart on the right.
themes.theme-rozwod: A child (age 6) walking happily between two parents in a sunlit park in autumn, holding a hand of each. The parents are at slight distance from each other but both leaning toward the child with warm smiles. Soft golden light through trees. Concept: secure and loved by both, even when family changes shape. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a heart on the right.
themes.theme-dzielenie-zabawkami: Two small children (around age 4, different hair colors) sitting on a colorful rug in a cozy playroom, one gently offering a small wooden toy to the other with a shy smile. The other child reaches out with a delighted expression. Warm afternoon light. Concept: a small generous moment. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a small heart on the right.
themes.theme-jedzenie: A bright sunlit kitchen scene: a child (age 4) sitting at a wooden table, looking with curious smile at a plate of colorful vegetables arranged in a fun friendly face shape. A parent visible from the side smiling encouragingly, not pressuring. Warm morning light through a window. Concept: making food feel friendly and playful. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon carrot sticker bottom-left and gold sparkles top-right.
themes.theme-spanie-samodzielne: A child (age 5) snuggled comfortably in their own twin bed, eyes peacefully closed, hugging a plush teddy bear. Soft blue glow from a star-shaped nightlight on a shelf. Through the slightly open door, a warm hallway light. Mood: cozy, brave, safe. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon teddy bear bottom-left and tiny stars top-right.
themes.theme-szkola: A child (age 7) walking confidently up a path toward a warm-looking school building in soft morning light, wearing a backpack. A parent walks slightly behind, smiling with pride and encouragement. Concept: brave first steps toward a new chapter. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a small heart on the right.
themes.theme-egzaminy: A child (age 9) sitting at a calm desk in a sunlit room, taking a deep breath with closed eyes, hands resting on an open notebook. A warm cup of cocoa beside them. Soft afternoon light. Concept: calm focus, breathing through pressure. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon golden sparkles top-right and a tiny heart on the right.
themes.theme-strata-zwierzaka: A child (age 7) cuddled in a fluffy blanket on a windowsill at twilight, looking up at the early evening sky. The child holds a small framed photo softly in their lap (frame is empty/blurred — just the gesture). A peaceful half-smile. Soft warm tones. Concept: keeping love after loss. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon paw print sticker bottom-left and a soft pink heart on the right.
themes.theme-rozstanie: A small child (age 3) standing in a doorway waving to a parent leaving for work, with a warm grandparent or other caregiver kneeling beside them with a gentle hand on their shoulder. The child's expression is brave, a little wistful but okay. Soft morning light. Concept: love stays connected even when apart. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon heart on the right and gold sparkles top-right.
themes.theme-niepowodzenie: A child (age 6) standing back up after falling off a small wooden bike in a sunny park, brushing dust off their knee with a determined small smile. A parent crouching nearby with an encouraging hand extended. Warm afternoon light through trees. Concept: getting back up. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a heart on the right.
themes.theme-burza: A child and parent cuddled inside a cozy blanket fort lit by a string of warm fairy lights, listening to soft rain through a window. The child has a contented small smile, holding a mug of warm cocoa. Mood: turning a scary storm into a magical adventure together. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon golden sparkles top-right and a heart on the right.
themes.theme-bohaterowie: A child (age 6) standing proudly in front of a tall mirror in a cozy bedroom, wearing a soft homemade superhero cape made of a colorful blanket. The child is mid-pose, beaming a huge confident smile. Warm morning light through window. Concept: discovering inner strength. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon golden sparkles top-right and a small heart on the right.
themes.theme-lekarz: A friendly pediatrician in a warm bright office holding a stethoscope to a child's plush teddy bear, while the child (age 4) watches with curious fascination, holding the bear in their lap. The doctor is smiling warmly. Bright sunlit office, soft pastel decor. Concept: medical visit as a friendly, gentle experience. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a cartoon teddy bear bottom-left and a heart on the right.
themes.theme-niesmialosc: A shy child (age 5) standing slightly to the side of a sunlit playground, watching another child approach with a friendly open smile and an offered small wildflower. The shy child's expression is just beginning to soften into a tentative smile. Warm afternoon light. Concept: a brave gentle first connection. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon sparkles top-right and a small heart bottom-left.
themes.theme-rodzenstwo-klotnia: Two siblings (around age 5 and 7) sitting back-to-back on a cozy rug in a sunlit room, arms crossed, but slowly turning their heads to peek at each other with growing reluctant smiles. Plush toys and books scattered around. Soft window light. Concept: tension melting into reconciliation. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with a heart on the right and cartoon sparkles top-right.
themes.theme-przeprowadzka: A child (age 6) sitting on a large cardboard moving box in a half-empty new bedroom, looking out a window at golden hour. A beloved teddy bear sits beside them. The child has a small thoughtful but hopeful smile. Soft warm afternoon light fills the empty room. Concept: bittersweet new beginning, full of possibility. Polaroid frame, slight rotation, with cartoon teddy bear bottom-left and gold sparkles top-right.
